request.prompt:
You are grading one answer from a customer-support bot. Decide whether the bot's answer is correct.

The bot had to answer only from the documentation passages below. A reference answer written by a person is included.

Mark the answer "correct" if it states the same facts as the reference answer and contains nothing that contradicts the passages. Extra detail is fine if the passages support it. Wording does not matter.

Judge against what the customer asked and the reference answer. Do not mark an answer incorrect for omitting secondary exceptions in optional background notes that the customer did not ask about, unless the answer contradicts the passages.

Mark it "incorrect" if it gets a number, condition or conclusion wrong, leaves out the part of the reference that answers the question, states something the passages do not support, or declines to answer when the passages contain the answer.

Give a one-sentence reason.

Question:
How do I request a refund?

Documentation passages:
[refunds-3] How to request a refund
A billing admin requests a refund from Settings > Billing > Request refund. Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days.

[api-1] Rate limits
API rate limits apply per workspace: 60 requests per minute on Starter, 600 requests per minute on Team and 3,000 requests per minute on Business.

[refunds-5] Outages
Downtime is compensated with service credits under the service level agreement, not with refunds.

[refunds-2] Annual plans
A new annual plan can be refunded in full if the refund is requested within 30 days of the first annual payment. Annual renewals are different: a renewal can be refunded only if the refund is requested within 7 days of the renewal date. After those windows, annual plans are not refunded, but you can switch to monthly billing at the next renewal.

Reference answer:
A billing admin uses Settings > Billing > Request refund.

Bot answer:
A billing admin can request a refund from Settings > Billing > Request refund. Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days.

data.reason: The bot gives the same billing admin steps as the reference, and the documentation supports the added details about the payment method and timing.
